title: Master's or PhD?
description: Before pursuing studies abroad, you need to understand what studying abroad involves, the academic and personal commitments required, the different admission pathways and the funding arrangements available across countries. This module helps you assess your readiness and decide whether studying abroad aligns with your academic background, research interests and long-term career goals.
topics: Types of PhD and entry requirements
